description: Two independent two-input mixers in one narrow panel, each crossfading between its pair of inputs

params.text: Crossfades between the two inputs of that half, one alone at each end of its travel and both at half level at the centre, despite the maker's tooltip calling it Volume

inputs.text: One of the two signals mixed in that half, carried alone when its MIX knob is fully counter-clockwise
One of the two signals mixed in that half, carried alone when its MIX knob is fully clockwise

outputs.text: The two inputs of that half blended as its MIX knob sets
